name: Heron Lakes (wetland parkland on the Columbia floodplain)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Heron Lakes Golf Club, West Delta Park, on the Columbia River floodplain in North Portland among sloughs, ponds and the Force Lake wetlands (course chat, 2026-11-13). From the OSIP 2024 summer photo (fairway #91a679, green #92ab82, water #617271, rough #8b9a75): mown turf a soft sage green, the rough between the holes and on Great Blue's mounds drier and more olive-tan; bunker sand pale grey; the ponds and sloughs a still, murky green-grey. Trees: mostly planted broadleaves (Oregon ash, black cottonwood, willow) with some Douglas fir (trees_heron_lakes.py; a drawing choice, the lidar gives only crown shape). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
